findings.title: defer f.Close() inside a loop keeps every file open
findings.description: defer inside the for loop only runs when LoadAll returns, so every opened file stays open until the whole slice is processed; a large paths slice exhausts file descriptors. Close the file per iteration (extract a helper that opens, reads and defers) or call f.Close() explicitly.
findings.suggestion: Move the open/read/close into a helper function so the defer runs per file, or close explicitly after readHeader.
